articles.summary: Paul Dick appointed President, North America, effective Jan. 1, 2027 Scott Harris to retire from role after 20 years with CNH and serve as senior advisor in 2027 Basildon, UK — November 20, 2026 — CNH Industrial N.V. (NYSE: CNH) today announced the appointment of Paul Dick as president, North America, effective Jan. 1, 2027. Dick will succeed Scott Harris, who is retiring next year after 20 distinguished years with the company. Harris will serve as president, North America, through Dec. 31. Beginning Jan. 1, Dick will assume the role, and Harris will remain with CNH as a senior advisor in 2027 to support a smooth transition. "Scott Harris has given CNH 20 remarkable years, and the North America business he leaves behind is stronger, more connected to our dealers and better positioned for the future because of him," said Gerrit Marx, Chief Executive Officer of CNH. articles.summary: CNH agriculture leader brings industry experience and customer insight to AEM. Basildon, UK — November 16, 2026 — CNH (NYSE: CNH) today announced that Kurt Coffey, Vice President, North America CNH Agriculture Marketing, has been named 2027 Chair of the Association of Equipment Manufacturers (AEM). In the role, Coffey will help guide AEM’s strategy and unite equipment manufacturers around shared industry priorities. “Equipment manufacturers are navigating significant change, but we also have a tremendous opportunity to move our industry forward by working together,” said Kurt Coffey, Vice President, North America CNH Agriculture Marketing. “My background in equipment manufacturing and long history across agriculture industry keep me focused on what matters most: helping customers succeed.
